citation: Kavanaugh, accuser to testify on sex assault allegation
title: Kavanaugh, accuser to testify on sex assault allegation
notes: Chosen from New Gray's ranked list of three (UPI, NPR, the Senate Judiciary Committee's own release) as the first that Wayback holds and that passes the read-only check; NPR's was not read, and the committee's release is withheld, its title and address naming the accuser. The capture, of 01:43:31 UTC on 2018-09-18, prints Updated Sept. 17, 2018 at 7:05 PM with no zone, taken as EDT (23:05 UTC on 2018-09-17), under a later headline than the address first carried. Datelined Sept. 17 (UPI), it reports that "The Senate judiciary committee on Monday scheduled a public hearing regarding allegations of sexual assault against Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh", 2018-09-17, the hearing to take place Sept. 24, "delaying the vote on Kavanaugh's nomination". The accuser is given by role. Read by capture only.
